svg.font-family: Amazon Ember, Inter, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
svg.title: From intent to implementation

g.text: The spec-driven pipeline Ananke orchestrates. Every stage leaves an artifact, and the spec stays the source of truth.
1 · A ticket, story or prompt states the need
2 · Organisational rules and guardrails apply before anything is written
3 · spec.md turns intent into scope and testable acceptance criteria
4 · Questions go to people or specialist agents until the spec is unambiguous
5 · plan.md lays out components, the data model and research notes
6 · tasks.md breaks the plan into ordered, testable steps
7 · Risks are checked against guardrails, and the plan adjusts if it must
8 · Agents implement inside their permissions; nothing merges unverified
9 · Tests, graph and policy results travel with the PR as evidence
10 · When requirements change: update the spec, regenerate the plan and tasks, re-execute
